chapter.verse: Note tawh maitang kimuh ciangin a meidawi, mundang ka tun ciangin note' tungah a hang, ci-a hong kigen keimah Paul in Khris' thunemna leh thudikna tawh note kong kun hi.
Cilesa tawh nungta ci-in hong ngaihsun mi kimkhatte' tungah sunglam kimuanna tawh ka lah lungsim hanna nam, note' kiangah kong tun ciangin lah a kul lo dingin kong thum hi.
A hang pen cilesa tawh nungta ka hih uh hangin cilesa tawh galdo ka hikei uh hi.
Kha galdona ah ka zat uh galhiamte pen cilesa tawh kibawl hilo a, galte' phualpi teng a sulawi zo ding Pasian' vangliatna a nei ahi hi.
Pasian theihna a lehpan thupomziate leh kiliatsakna nam khempeuh ka sulawi uh a, Khris' thumang a suah nadingun lungsim khempeuh ka mancip uh hi.
Na thumanna uh a kicin ciangin thumanglo khempeuh ka gawt ding uh a, tua dingin a kigingsa ka hi uh hi.
Note' mai-a om pen en dih un. Mi khatpeuh Khris mi ka hi ci-in a kimuan leh amah bang lianin kote zong Khris mi ka hihlam uh amahmah kiphawngtawm ta hen.
A hang pen note kong suksiat nading uh ahilo, kong lambeh nading uh-a Topa' hong piak komau' thuneihna vai, tawm bang kong kisialhbeh phial leh zong tua hangin ka maizum nading thu om lo hi.
Kong laikhakte tawh note hong lausak nuam ka bat ding ka ut kei hi.
A hang pen amaute in, “Ama' hong laikhakte thuguh thukhauh vive hi a, ama' pumpi ahihleh thazawmin a thugente zong mumal mel nei lo hi,” ci uh hi.
Tua banga a pau mi in theitel ta hen: ka om loh uh sunga laikhak tawh kong gente uh, kong om theih uh ciangin a sem ka hi uh hi.

Tua bang ka cih ciangin amauleamau a kiphattawm mi kimkhatte tawh ka kikhat uh a ci ngam, a kitehkak ngam ka hikei uh hi. Amau teng mah khatlekhat ki-enkakin amau teng mah khatlekhat kitehkak uh ahih manin amaumah thu theitel lo uh ahi hi.
Ahi zongin luangletin ka kisial kei ding uh a, note' kiang ciangdong nangawn kong phakzawhna uh, Pasian' hong khenkhiat nasepna huang thu bek mah kong kisial ding uh hi.
A hang pen Khris' Lungdamna Thu tawh note' kiangah hong pai masate ka hi uh a, no' kiang ciangdong hong pha lo bangin a khengvalin a gamta ka hikei uh hi.
Midangte' nasepna hangin luangletin ka kisial kei uh hi. Kote' lamet ahihleh na upna uh hong khangin note' laka ka nasepna huang uh nakpi hong tangzai ding cih ahi hi.
Tua hileh midang khat ii nasepna huang sunga a kisem khinsate kisialhpih se lo-in no teng' khen-a gamte ah Lungdamna Thu a va tangko thei ding ka hi uh hi.
“A kisial mi peuhmah Topa' hang bekin kisial ta hen.”
Banghanghiam cihleh pahtak ngah i cihte pen amauleamau a kiphattawmte hilo-in Topa' phatna a ngahte ahi hi.
